_pr7_node_unification.description: Node system unification — aligned registry with PR-6 audit results

startup_policy_semantics.active: Node is healthy and orchestrated; start unconditionally
startup_policy_semantics.optional: Node has a valid role but needs work; start if available, skip on failure
startup_policy_semantics.skip: Node is archived, deleted, or a stub; do NOT include in any startup path

audit_action_semantics.repair: Valuable role; config drift resolved; marked optional until fully verified
audit_action_semantics.archive: Non-trivial stub preserved for reference; excluded from active startup
audit_action_semantics.delete: Placeholder with no unique value; excluded from active startup

_pr6_policy_normalization.description: Normalize node registry fields and formalize startup policy state machine
_pr6_policy_normalization.change: All 95 previously-implicit active nodes now carry an explicit startup_policy: "active" field. The registry is now fully normalized: every node entry has an explicit startup_policy.

transitions.optional -> active: Node passes integration test and health check; maintainer updates field in node_dependencies.json
transitions.active -> optional: Node develops a known issue or config drift; maintainer demotes to allow soft-fail startup
transitions.active -> skip: Node is retired, archived, or identified as a stub with no unique value
transitions.optional -> skip: Repair attempt abandoned; node archived or deleted

_startup_tier_model.description: Defines the canonical 3-tier startup model for the Galaxy runtime. Tiers are derived from existing startup_policy and group metadata — no new governance authority is introduced.

Core.description: Minimum canonical runtime boot. Starts the essential system foundation.
Core.acceptance: All Core nodes must start successfully. System cannot be considered runnable if any Core node fails.

Standard.description: Normal development and functional boot. Adds active development/tooling nodes to Core.
Standard.acceptance: All Standard nodes must start successfully for a full development session. Core failures remain blocking.

Full.description: Broad runtime boot — all active and optional nodes. Mirrors the full production node surface.
Full.acceptance: All active nodes must start. Optional node failures are tolerated (soft-fail). skip nodes are never started.

invariants: Core ⊂ Standard ⊂ Full (each tier is a strict superset of the previous)
startup_policy is the canonical governance field — tiers are a read-only view over it
The "skip" policy excludes nodes from all tiers unconditionally
Tier membership is derived at runtime from node_dependencies.json — no separate tier registry
